description: Calculate the minimal payments to settle up balances among participants. Use when you need to resolve debts after a shared expense. Do NOT use when you need to plan a series of payments over time, use rotation_plan instead.

currency.description: Currency code, as a string, ISO 4217

participants.description: List of participant names, as strings in an array

shares.description: Each participant's share of the total cost, as numbers in an array

total_cost.description: Total amount spent, as a number

name: settle_up

balances.description: The net balance for each participant after settling up.

balance.description: The net balance for the participant.

transactions.description: The minimal set of transactions to settle up all balances.

from.description: The name of the participant paying.

to.description: The name of the participant receiving.

title: Settle up
